defects.fix: Compute month_end without building the next month's first day: use calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]. In months_between, stop the loop when month_end(first) >= end.
defects.if_skipped: Valid dates in December 9999 are rejected with a misleading error. Only matters for dates at the limit of datetime.

advisory.problem: AC-011 "changes nothing" is checked only on a ledger that was empty before. No test adds a valid expense, then a rejected one, then checks that the earlier state is intact. Every bad case would still leave balances() equal to {}, so a partial record is only caught if it adds a name to balances().
advisory.evidence: An add() that appended the expense to the list after validating, but raised ValueError only afterwards, would still be caught. One that stored just the amount, with no names, would not.

advisory.problem: The strict-ISO rejection list has only "2026-1-5" as a wrongly formatted string. It does not include other forms such as "20260105" or " 2026-01-05".
